jobs.title: Administrative Operations Assistant
jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Administrative Operations Assistant to support our Vice President, Oklo Isotopes and team as it builds a vertically integrated, domestic supply of critical radioisotopes. Position Description Oklo is seeking an experienced, dynamic, technically capable Administrative Operations Assistant to support the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, and the broader radioisotope production and vertical-integration effort. This role demands a combination of administrative prowess and the agility to navigate a fast-moving company at the frontier of advanced fission (nuclear energy) and the domestic production of critical radioisotopes for healthcare, industry, research, and national security. Discretion is essential to this role. The Administrative Operations Assistant will regularly handle highly technical, sensitive, and confidential information across the Isotopes vertical, including proprietary technical data, regulatory and licensing materials, partner and vendor agreements, personnel matters, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and information subject to U.S. export-control laws. The role may also require access to regulated facilities operating under government oversight. Given the significance and scope of this work, the successful candidate must demonstrate sound judgment and treat confidentiality, compliance, and accountability as fundamental responsibilities of the position. Employment will be contingent upon the candidate’s ability to satisfy all applicable export-control, CUI-handling, background-screening, and facility-access requirements. There is a preference for candidates located in Eastern or Central time zones. Specific responsibilities may include: Provide comprehensive support to the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, including calendar management, coordinating meetings, and handling travel arrangements Efficiently process and distill a high volume of incoming information, presenting it in a prioritized manner to the Vice President Oklo Isotopes and team, and facilitating subsequent actions Prepare and edit presentations, reports, and other critical documents, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery Manage confidential information with discretion, upholding the company’s data protection standards Proactively address and resolve administrative and technical challenges Assist with project coordination, ensuring milestones are met and updates are communicated effectively Handle ad-hoc tasks and projects as required, showcasing resourcefulness and adaptability Schedule events with key stakeholders efficiently and smoothly During the initial phase of this role, the successful candidate may provide temporary on-site logistics and administrative support while the company recruits a dedicated full-time facilities professional. Responsibilities may include coordinating the setup of temporary office trailers, arranging regular deliveries of water, beverages, and snacks, establishing janitorial services, and supporting events and hospitality for site visitors. This interim support will help ensure smooth and professional site operations until the facilities position is filled. Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience 5-8 years proven experience as an assistant or in a similar role, with a preference for those familiar with technical environments Serve as a calendar strategist, prioritizing and sequencing meetings to advance key objectives—not simply scheduling appointments Strong technical proficiency with the ability to quickly adapt to new tools and software, including Google Suite, Slack, Box, Atlassian, Asana, Microsoft Office Suite, and Adobe Acrobat to make tracked changes, add redlining/comments to documents, and create PDFs Familiarity with AI tools is a plus — and/or a willingness to learn new tools to work more efficiently Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, multitask, and prioritize tasks A proactive mindset, with the ability to anticipate needs and challenges U.S. citizenship is required for the compliance reasons outlined above Bonus Qualifications: Knowledge of the nuclear power industry and isotopes is a plus but not required Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred Competencies We are looking for an Administrative Operations Assistant who is: Handles confidential and technical information with the utmost discretion, sharing it only with authorized individuals and through approved systems Understands and respects access boundaries, approvals, data-protection standards, and export-control requirements, and escalates promptly when something is unclear Provides steady, reliable support the department can depend on — closing loops, following through, and safeguarding the accuracy and security of information at every step Exercises sound judgment about what may be discussed, with whom, and in what setting, protecting the confidentiality of the department, its partners, and the company Passionate about clean energy  Passionate about making advanced fission a reality Willing and able to learn quickly Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us Willing to think differently and do things in new ways  Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before  Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well! Able to communicate technical content and results verbally  Who you are: A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that. Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals. A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team. An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator. Creative : Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day. Detail-oriented : This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.   About Oklo travel requirements: Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.   About Oklo compensation: Salary: $70,000-$90,000 Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits. This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible. About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories. #CHOP: Oklo’s Values Collaboration : We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes. Humility : We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition. Ownership : We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through  to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy. Pathfinding : We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity. Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws. Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address. All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process. If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for an Associate General Counsel, Energy & Regulatory to join our Legal team. Position Description The Associate General Counsel, Energy & Regulatory will play a critical role helping us navigate a wide range of energy-related legal, regulatory, and public policy matters, as we continue to develop, build, and scale our powerhouse fleet. We are looking for an attorney with 7-10 years of energy regulatory experience, with substantial experience managing FERC and State Public Utility Commission (PUC) engagements and submissions, and supporting interconnection applications.  This person’s primary responsibilities will be to lead our FERC, State PUC, and interconnection-related legal work, including representing Oklo in FERC and PUC proceedings and supporting interconnection agreements and processes. They will also support energy-related policy work, including monitoring and engaging in FERC and related regulatory rulemaking efforts, monitoring relevant policy developments with ISOs and RTOs, and working closely with our government affairs team on federal, state, and local legislative engagements. Beyond FERC and energy-related regulatory support, they will support other pre-construction regulatory and zoning efforts, including supporting environmental reviews and engagements, and local zoning and permitting work, leveraging outside counsel as needed. Note that we have a dedicated team to handle nuclear regulatory engagement with the NRC and Department of Energy, and that work is outside of the scope of this role (although you will certainly work in coordination with them on related matters). This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge nuclear energy technology and energy regulatory law. The ideal candidate will have deep experience in FERC practice and energy project development, and will bring hands-on experience navigating complex regulatory approval processes. As a high-growth company, you will also help with other legal needs across the company as they arise. This role, which reports directly to our General Counsel, is perfect for an experienced energy regulatory attorney who is ready to roll up their sleeves and help a growing company navigate (and improve) a complex regulatory landscape.  We are not looking for someone who is looking to operate in a silo: we are a lean team and hire lawyers who are great at what they do, but are excited to do work beyond their areas of expertise. Oklo is growing fast and every day presents new opportunities and challenging legal questions—we care more about you and your ability to learn and grow than your specific substantive experience or which boxes you check. If you are someone who thrives in exciting and fast-moving environments, and are eager to grow and push yourself, this role may be for you. Specific responsibilities may include: Lead all FERC-related legal matters, including filings, compliance, and proceedings before FERC; advise on generator interconnection processes, wholesale power market rules, and transmission access matters; Support energy-related public policy work, including monitoring FERC and other regulatory rulemakings and participating in comment processes; Work closely with our government affairs team on federal, state, and local legislative and regulatory initiatives; Support pre-construction regulatory and zoning work, including environmental reviews (NEPA and state equivalents), local permitting, land use approvals, and siting matters, managing outside counsel as needed; Help to review and negotiate interconnection agreements, and support our commercial legal team with energy-related requirements in agreements being negotiated; and Track regulatory developments across key jurisdictions and advise business teams on regulatory strategy and compliance risk. jobs.title: Commercial Quality Program Manager
jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Commercial Quality Program Manager to build and lead a practical, high-performing quality program that helps our teams move quickly while delivering consistently excellent results. Position Description The Commercial Quality Program Manager will own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Oklo's commercial Quality Management System (QMS) using ISO 9001 as the governing standard. This role will translate quality requirements into scalable, business-focused processes; partner closely with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Project Management, Operations, Records and Document Control; and coordinate with Nuclear Quality Assurance to ensure applicable commercial and nuclear quality requirements are clearly defined, integrated, and met. The successful candidate will be a hands-on builder who can move seamlessly between strategy, systems, coaching, and execution. Specific responsibilities may include: Lead the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Oklo's commercial QMS in alignment with ISO 9001 requirements and business objectives. Translate customer, contractual, technical, regulatory, and internal requirements into clear policies, procedures, workflows, tools, and measurable controls. Establish a risk-based and graded approach to commercial quality so that controls are rigorous, efficient, and proportionate to the risk, complexity, and intended use of products and services. Coordinate closely with Nuclear Quality Assurance to determine when nuclear quality requirements apply and to maintain clear interfaces, handoffs, escalation paths, and ownership across quality programs. Lead internal audits, management reviews, quality objectives, corrective action activities, and other QMS governance processes, ensuring issues are identified early and driven to effective closure. Partner with cross-functional teams to embed quality planning and controls into design, procurement, supplier management, manufacturing, inspection, testing, delivery, and operational activities. Develop and oversee commercial supplier quality controls, including qualification, performance monitoring, issue resolution, and improvement, while coordinating with Nuclear Quality Assurance for suppliers or items that cross quality program boundaries. Manage nonconformances, corrective and preventive actions, root cause evaluations, deviations, concessions, and effectiveness reviews with an emphasis on timely, durable, and data-driven solutions. Define and maintain meaningful quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting that provide leadership with clear insight into performance, risk, trends, and opportunities for improvement. Create and deliver practical training, coaching, and guidance that help employees understand quality requirements and confidently apply them in their day-to-day work. Support customer, partner, and third-party assessments or audits, and ensure resulting actions are coordinated, documented, and completed on schedule. Champion a culture of quality, ownership, learning, and continuous improvement that strengthens execution, reduces rework, and enables Oklo to scale with speed and discipline. Minimum Qualifications: 7+ years of quality assurance, quality engineering, operations, manufacturing, or related experience, including at least 3 years leading a quality program or management system in a complex or regulated environment. Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and demonstrated experience implementing, maintaining, improving, or auditing an ISO 9001-based QMS. Bachelor's degree in engineering, quality, operations, physical science, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and convert requirements into practical business processes. Remote work capability and ability to use video conferencing and cloud-based applications; willing and able to travel approximately 25% of workdays. Bonus Qualifications: ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification or an ASQ certification such as Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Quality Engineer, or Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence. Experience in nuclear energy, advanced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, EPC, or another highly regulated, technically complex industry. Familiarity with nuclear quality assurance requirements, such as ASME NQA-1, ANSI/ANS-15.8, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, or Department of Energy quality requirements, and experience integrating commercial and nuclear quality controls. Competencies We are looking for a high-energy quality leader who has a thorough understanding of: ISO 9001 principles, including the process approach, risk-based thinking, Plan-Do-Check-Act, customer focus, leadership, performance evaluation, and continual improvement. Quality program design, governance, document control, configuration management, audit practices, management review, nonconformance control, corrective action, and root cause analysis. jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo! This is an open call for all kinds of engineers and other professionals interested in joining our fuel recycling team! Oklo is preparing to deploy the first modern U.S. fuel recycling facility. This requires specialty work in areas including design, R&D, program management, operations, physical protection and safeguarding, MC&A, and many more. If the nuclear fuel cycle is your passion - we would like to speak with you! If you don’t see a currently-posted position that aligns with your specialty, experience, or interests, we invite you to submit your resume to this posting, along with a cover letter that describes why specifically you feel that you would be a great addition to our team. #LI-DNI Competencies: We are looking for exceptional individuals that are: Passionate about clean energy, and making advanced fission a reality Motivated by building, and getting technology deployed Energized by tackling and overcoming challenges Willing and able to learn quickly Willing to think differently and do things in new ways  Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly-iterative startup environment Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before  Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems Able to communicate technical content and results verbally Excellent writers who can write in a modern active voice (so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!)   Who you are: A startup person:  You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process.  You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team.  If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us!  There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that. Motivated: You are self-motivated.  You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance!  It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals. A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others.  We do incredible things because we work as a team. An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator. Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day. Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Even excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.   About Oklo travel requirements: Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.   About Oklo compensation: Salary: $75k-175k Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, competitive pay, 401k, health insurance, FSA, flexible work hours, and other benefits. About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories. #CHOP: Oklo’s Values Collaboration : We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes. They will spend time between fabrication, assembly, test setup, instrumentation, and data capture. jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Head of Isotopes Supply Chain to join our Isotopes team.  Position Description Oklo Isotopes is hiring a Head of Isotopes Supply Chain to own one of the hardest problems in our business: moving radioactive products that lose value by the hour through a thin, unforgiving carrier network, and doing it so reliably that customers build their operations around us. Many of our products are perishable; a day lost in transit is product lost forever. This is not a freight-desk role. It is a design-and-own role for a capability we consider a moat This person will own radioactive packaging, carrier and route qualification, shipment execution, and contingency planning across the division. They will build the Class 7 shipping capability: packaging selection and licensing, trained hazmat personnel, classification and documentation, qualified carriers and routes, and the redundancy that turns a fragile chain into a dependable one. They will also carry logistics requirements into our biggest decisions, including facility siting and design. Success means produced activity becomes delivered revenue, customers experience us as the most dependable shipper in the industry, and logistics constraints are designed into our plans rather than discovered after them. Location: Santa Clara, CA or site-based, with regular travel to our facilities, carriers, and customers. Specific responsibilities may include: Own end-to-end logistics for radioactive products: packaging, classification, documentation, tendering, carrier management, delivery confirmation, and returns. Build and qualify the Class 7 network: Type A and Type B packaging programs, carrier and route qualification, specialized couriers and air-cargo partners, and station-level acceptance. Design redundancy: backup routes, backup carriers, and recovery playbooks for missed pickups, refused tenders, and in-transit failures on time-critical shipments. Own trained hazmat shipping personnel, procedures, and compliance across our sites. Carry logistics requirements into facility siting, production scheduling, and customer commitments, so that transit time and route risk are priced into every decision. Build relationships with the small set of carriers, brokers, and handlers that accept radioactive material, and make Oklo their favorite customer. Measure and publish delivery performance, and drive it toward industry-leading on-time, in-full delivery. Minimum Qualifications: 8+ years in logistics or transportation of dangerous goods, with direct experience shipping Class 7 radioactive material by road and air. Working knowledge of DOT, IATA, and NRC transport requirements, package types, and shipper responsibilities. Demonstrated experience building or running a time-critical shipping operation, ideally for perishable or short-shelf-life products. Experience qualifying and managing carriers, couriers, and freight partners in a thin-capacity network. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including customer-facing communication under pressure. Bonus Qualifications : Experience shipping radiopharmaceuticals, medical isotopes, or sealed sources. Hazmat or dangerous goods certifications (for example, DOT hazmat, IATA DG). Experience informing facility siting or network design decisions with logistics analysis. Experience standing up logistics operations in a startup or fast-growth environment. Competencies We are looking for a Head of Logistics that is: An owner of outcomes: judged by delivered shipments, not by tendered ones. Deeply practical about regulated transport: someone who knows what actually happens at a cargo station at 5 a.m., not only what the regulation says. A designer of systems and playbooks, not a heroic firefighter, though capable of firefighting when it counts. Calm and decisive on time-critical failures, with customers kept informed rather than surprised. Comfortable with direct communication, candid feedback, regulatory complexity, shifting priorities, and regular travel. This person will help ensure compliance with nuclear industry standards and foster a culture of hardware excellence. This role focuses on strategic oversight, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional collaboration to optimize efficiency, quality, and safety in nuclear reactor component manufacturing. Ensure quality assurance records, quality control inspection records, and construction completion documentation are complete, legible, accurate, traceable, and retrievable, and oversee the assembly, review, acceptance, and turnover of final project records and data packages. Lead efforts to prevent and identify counterfeit, fraudulent, and suspect items and ensure potential concerns are controlled, evaluated, documented, escalated, and reported in accordance with applicable requirements. jobs.title: Senior Neutronics Engineer - Isotope Production
jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Senior Neutronics Engineer to join our engineering team. Position Description The Senior Neutronics Engineer is responsible for developing and executing neutronics analyses supporting the design, optimization, operation, and safety evaluation of an isotope production reactor. The engineer will perform analyses to support core design, fuel cycle, target performance, shielding, and sensitivity/uncertainty quantification across the reactor lifecycle and isotope production facility. This role requires close collaboration with thermal hydraulics, mechanical design, materials, isotope processing, operations, safety, and licensing teams. The engineer will translate system and production objectives into analysis requirements; develop appropriate computational models and methods; and produce technically sound, traceable, and defensible results. Areas of analysis include criticality, depletion, isotope production, target optimization, shielding, activation, source term, and sensitivity/uncertainty analysis. The isotope division is a small but growing team so the candidate must be capable of operating in a highly iterative and independent environment. Specific responsibilities may include: Perform reactor core design and optimization using Monte Carlo and, where appropriate, deterministic neutron transport methods. Develop and execute models using codes such as MCNP, Serpent, and SCALE Perform core lifecycle and fuel management analyses, including depletion, burnup, reactivity evolution, power distributions, fuel utilization, and operating cycle optimization. Evaluate core physics parameters, including excess reactivity, control element worth, shutdown margin, reactivity coefficients, kinetics parameters, and criticality safety margins. Design and optimize irradiation targets to meet isotope yield, specific activity, radionuclidic purity, heat limits, and production schedule objectives. Perform depletion, activation, decay, and transmutation analyses for fuel, targets, structural materials, experimental hardware, and reactor components. Develop neutron and photon source terms for shielding, activation, decay heat, dose, and isotope processing evaluations. Perform shielding analyses using variance reduction techniques. Apply sensitivity and uncertainty methods using tools such as TSUNAMI and SAMPLER to quantify nuclear data, modeling, and manufacturing uncertainties. Establish appropriate biases and uncertainties to establish design margins. Develop, qualify, and maintain computational methods, analysis procedures, cross-section libraries, and reference models. Perform verification and validation using critical experiments, shielding benchmarks, depletion benchmarks, operating data, and applicable international benchmark programs. Support the design and evaluation of startup testing, physics measurements, irradiation experiments, and reactor surveillance activities. Couple neutronics results with thermal hydraulic, mechanical, isotope processing, and safety analyses. Perform design space exploration and optimization across competing objectives such as isotope production, fuel utilization, power peaking, irradiation damage, cycle length, and safety margin. Develop repeatable analysis workflows using modern software development practices, including configuration control, automated testing, code review, and reproducible data processing. Provide timely technical feedback to rapidly iterating multidisciplinary design teams. Document assumptions, methods, results, uncertainties, and limitations in clear technical reports. Support design reviews, safety evaluations, licensing activities, and responses to regulatory questions. Minimum Qualifications: If you have experience and expertise in reactor design, apply!
